note: Set A covers the blade-pitch controller's design model, the gain-scheduled PI control method, the speed-error input, and the generator-torque controller's Region-3 override condition (previous blade-pitch command 1º or greater), all supported by the page. Set B's seven claims are a strict subset of A's and are all correct, but it omits these important controller facts. A's only flaw is that the gain-scheduled PI control-method claim is stated twice; B has no errors of its own but is incomplete.
remarks: Set A repeats the gain-scheduled PI control-method claim verbatim (claims 7 and 9). Both sets correctly capture the torque saturation (47,402.91 N•m = 10% above rated) and the 15,000 N•m/s rate limit; neither set extracts the equation of motion (7-5), which is arguably an important fact on the page.
